decisions.reason: Its move from a simple mention to its own page suggests results above aspiration, and as a low-risk complement to core flooring sales it is worth retaining.
Its visibility did not improve, which points to only satisfactory or uncertain results, but it fits the established maintenance system and the firm likely keeps it while performance is clarified.
The upgrade to a dedicated page indicates favorable market feedback relative to aspiration, so management would continue it as part of the aftercare portfolio.
This underlay appears to have performed around aspiration rather than clearly above it, yet it supports the core flooring offer and can be carried with available organizational slack.
The product stayed only briefly presented on the website, implying middling results, but because it is close to existing system sales the firm is more likely to keep than drop it immediately.
A new oak parquet floor sits close to the firm's main competence and customer base, and absent clear signs of failure management would normally continue it for another year.
